title: 상사에게 휴가 신청하기: 언제 쉬게요?
objective: Ask your manager for annual leave politely and understand 언제 쉬게요?
summary: An employee asks her team leader for three days of annual leave.
setting: At the office. Lina goes to her team leader's desk to ask for annual leave next month.

task.title: Practice asking for leave
task.line: Use the words, the dialogue, and the -게요? pattern to complete each item.

words.meaning: asks about someone's plan: 'what/when/where are you going to…?' (often a little surprised)
words.exampleMeaning: What are you planning to do this weekend?

words.meaning: to take a day of paid annual leave
words.exampleMeaning: I'm taking Friday off to go to the hospital.

words.example: 부장님이 아직 제 휴가를 승인하지 않으셨어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My manager hasn't approved my leave yet.

words.meaning: to hand over your work to a coworker
words.example: 출장 가기 전에 업무를 후배에게 인수인계했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Before my business trip, I handed my work over to a junior coworker.

words.meaning: to be away from your desk for a while
words.example: 내일 오후에는 제가 잠깐 자리를 비울 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'll be away from my desk for a bit tomorrow afternoon.

words.example: 감기 때문에 사흘 동안 회사에 못 갔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I couldn't go to work for three days because of a cold.

dialogue.korean: 팀장님, 잠깐 시간 괜찮으세요? 휴가 일로 드릴 말씀이 있어서요.
dialogue.meaning: Team leader, do you have a moment? I have something to tell you about my vacation.
Sure, have a seat. When are you planning to take off?
I'd like to use my annual leave from the 10th to the 12th next month.

dialogue.korean: 그 주에 신제품 발표가 있잖아요. 발표 준비는 어떻게 하게요?
dialogue.meaning: We have the new product presentation that week, you know. What are you going to do about preparing for it?

dialogue.korean: 자료는 휴가 전까지 다 끝내 놓겠습니다. 나머지 일은 지훈 씨한테 인수인계해 두고요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll finish all the materials before my leave. And I'll hand the rest of my work over to Jihun.

dialogue.korean: 알았어요. 시스템에 휴가 신청서를 올리면 바로 승인할게요.
dialogue.meaning: Okay. Once you submit your leave request in the system, I'll approve it right away.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -게요? (만들다): 마트에서 고기를 이렇게 많이 사네요. 뭐 ____?
Fill in the blank with one word from the list (인수인계, 승인, 사흘): 다음 주에 휴가라서 오늘 동료에게 제 일을 ____했어요.
Answer in Korean, based on the dialogue: ① 리나 씨는 며칠 쉬어요? ② 리나 씨가 쉬는 동안 나머지 일은 누가 해요?
Answer in Korean: Your manager asks, "다음 주에 언제 쉬게요?" You want to take Monday off as annual leave.
answers: ① 사흘이요. (10일부터 12일까지요.) ② 지훈 씨가 해요.
월요일에 연차를 쓰고 싶습니다. (월요일에 쉬고 싶습니다.)
